evidence: The interface composition and stability upon thermal oxidation and high-k atomic layer deposition were studied, and it was found that an oxygen monolayer bonding to In atoms forms the interface between the InAs substrate and the HfO2 film grown on top. The growth rate of HfO2 in commercial ALD reactors is typically less than 1.5 Å per cycle, but in this study, a full monolayer (5.6 Å) of HfOx was formed after the first half-cycle.
